description: Shared Renovate policy for every ninoverse repository. Extend it with { "extends": ["github>ninoverse/.github"] } — a repository with no renovate.json is skipped by the central run, so this file is opt-in. Presets carry no $schema: they are merged into the consumer's config rather than validated as one.

packageRules.description: One PR a week for everything non-breaking. A PR per dependency is noise, and each one costs a full CI run.
Actions move together and are low risk; keeping them in one PR keeps the workflow diffs readable.
Majors stay separate — they are the ones that need a changelog read, and a minimum-toolchain job is the usual thing they break.

Never touch the MSRV job's toolchain. It is pinned to the rust-version in Cargo.toml on purpose; bumping it would leave the job green while it silently stopped testing the MSRV at all. Raising the MSRV is a deliberate change made in Cargo.toml and clippy.toml together. Matches nothing in non-Rust repositories.

customManagers.description: The github-actions manager does not read `with:` inputs, so a pinned Renovate version is picked up from its annotation comment instead.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes ignore the weekly window and the major-approval gate — waiting until Monday for a known advisory defeats the point.
